hunks.baseline: A clear blue expanse without a single cloud. But to the black knight’s eyes, which had already lost their light, it appeared only as a dark, murky gray.
hunks.sol: A clear blue expanse without a single cloud. But to the black knight’s eyes, which had long since lost their light, it appeared only as a dark, murky gray.

hunks.baseline: The thought that suddenly occurred to him left the black knight feeling strange. Dark? What did darkness even mean?
hunks.sol: The thought left him feeling strangely unsettled. Dark? What did darkness even mean?

hunks.baseline: He had been a black knight from the beginning. A being born from darkness does not know what darkness means.
hunks.sol: He had always been a black knight. A being born from darkness could not understand what darkness was.

hunks.baseline: Several words and inexplicable scenes flashed through his mind in succession, leaving him confused.
hunks.sol: The words and inexplicable scenes flashed through his mind one after another, leaving him confused.

hunks.baseline: If not for the call from one of his subordinates a moment later, the black knight would have stood there for a long time.
hunks.sol: If not for his subordinate calling to him a moment later, the black knight might have stood there for a long time.

hunks.baseline: Black armor as dark as night covered his entire body. Green lights flickered between the slits of the helmet covering his head.
hunks.sol: Pitch-black armor covered them from head to toe. Green light flickered through the slits of the helmets concealing their heads.

hunks.baseline: Two Death Knights dismounted from their skeletal warhorses and knelt on one knee. Their voices were flat as they continued.
hunks.sol: Two Death Knights dismounted from their skeletal warhorses and knelt on one knee. They continued in flat, emotionless voices.

hunks.baseline: The black knight recalled something he had briefly forgotten. It was the command given by the lord he served.
hunks.sol: The black knight recalled something he had briefly forgotten: the command given by the lord he served.

hunks.baseline: He had appointed the ten Death Knights under his command to lead five legions, then personally taken command of one legion’s vanguard and come here.
hunks.sol: He had appointed the ten Death Knights under his command to lead five legions, then personally taken the vanguard of one legion and come here.

hunks.baseline: It was a place he remembered. A place where the unfamiliar word *child* had suddenly come to mind, and where he had sensed an enormous power whose nature he could not identify.
hunks.sol: It was a place he remembered. The place where the unfamiliar word *child* had suddenly come to mind, and where he had sensed an enormous power whose nature he could not identify.

hunks.baseline: But the black knight did not know why he had come here.
hunks.sol: But the black knight had no idea why he had come here.

hunks.baseline: Hearing the answer they had been waiting for, the Death Knights mounted their skeletal warhorses and raised their enormous spears high.
hunks.sol: Having received the answer they had been waiting for, the Death Knights mounted their skeletal warhorses and raised their enormous spears high.

hunks.baseline: Demonic qi surged from the spearheads, and the monsters packed across the broad plain let out shrill howls.
hunks.sol: Pitch-black demonic qi surged from the spearheads, and the monsters packed across the broad plain let out shrill howls.

hunks.baseline: From Skeletons that had died only recently and still had flesh clinging to their bones, to small monsters like goblins and Orcs, and large monsters such as Trolls and ogres…
hunks.sol: There were Skeletons that had died so recently that flesh still clung to their bones, small monsters such as goblins and Orcs, and large monsters such as Trolls and ogres.

hunks.baseline: Their numbers reached tens of thousands by a rough estimate. In the sky, groups of Gargoyles and Wyverns cast enormous shadows over the land.
hunks.sol: By a rough estimate, they numbered in the tens of thousands. Overhead, flocks of Gargoyles and Wyverns cast enormous shadows across the land.

hunks.baseline: At the next command, roughly two hundred Dullahans formed ranks. Holding their severed heads in one hand and weapons in the other, they rode atop beasts made of white bones, their eyes gleaming with ferocity.
hunks.sol: At the next command, roughly two hundred Dullahans formed ranks. Holding their severed heads in one hand and weapons in the other, they sat astride beasts made of white bone, their eyes gleaming with a vicious light.

hunks.baseline: The two Death Knights formed the tip of the legion. Their spearheads rose high enough to pierce the sky, then slowly descended until they pointed toward the city.
hunks.sol: The two Death Knights took position at the tip of the legion. Their spearheads, raised as if to pierce the sky, slowly descended to point toward the city.

hunks.baseline: —Public Security Armed Forces Department, assemble!
hunks.sol: “Public Security Armed Forces Department, assemble!”

hunks.baseline: —F-fuck! Monsters! They’ve appeared!
hunks.sol: “F-fuck! Monsters! They’re here!”

hunks.baseline: —Sound the alarm immediately and report to command!
hunks.sol: “Sound the alarm and report to command immediately!”

hunks.baseline: The cries of the humans and the sound announcing the emergency carried on the wind.
hunks.sol: The humans’ shouts and the wail of the emergency siren carried on the wind.

hunks.baseline: Ranks and files arranged with military precision.
hunks.sol: The ranks and files were arranged with military precision.

hunks.baseline: Death Knights and Dullahans led the way, with fast-moving Lycanthropes and other monsters at the very front. Large monsters such as ogres, Trolls, and Golems advanced like a gigantic wall.
hunks.sol: Death Knights and Dullahans led the way, with highly mobile Lycanthropes and other monsters holding the front line. Large monsters such as ogres, Trolls, and Golems advanced behind them like a colossal wall.

hunks.baseline: Monsters capable of using bows and magic had long since moved to the rear.
hunks.sol: The monsters capable of using bows and magic had already moved to the rear.

hunks.baseline: The black knight was also the one who had conceived of the discipline and formations that ordinary monsters lacked.
hunks.sol: The black knight was the one who had devised the discipline and formations ordinary monsters lacked.

hunks.baseline: *Where did I learn something like this?*
hunks.sol: *Where did I learn such things?*

hunks.baseline: In accordance with their master’s will, the skeletal warhorse he rode began to move.
hunks.sol: At its master’s will, the skeletal warhorse beneath him began to move.

hunks.baseline: Hooves made of white bone trampled the new shoots beneath them. The undead legion blanketing the vast breadbasket advanced slowly behind its commander.
hunks.sol: Hooves of white bone trampled the new shoots beneath them. The undead legion blanketing the vast breadbasket advanced slowly behind its commander.

hunks.baseline: The earth shook beneath the enormous vibration. The legion, moving forward like a slow wave, soon became a wave of bones that swept across the plain.
hunks.sol: Tremors shook the earth. The legion moved forward like a slow swell, then became a wave of bones sweeping across the plain.

hunks.baseline: The enormous roar of tens of thousands of monsters.
hunks.sol: Tens of thousands of monsters roared as one.

hunks.baseline: At the head of the monsters surging toward the city, the black knight shot forward like a streak of light.
hunks.sol: At the head of the horde surging toward the city, the black knight shot forward like a streak of light.

hunks.baseline: —That one’s the leader!
hunks.sol: “That one’s the leader!”

hunks.baseline: —Ranged units! Prepare!
hunks.sol: “Ranged units! Prepare!”

hunks.baseline: —Tanks, stay calm! The armored units will intercept him alongside the Hunters!
hunks.sol: “Tanks, hold your ground! Armored units, intercept him with the Hunters!”

hunks.baseline: The black knight could hear the humans shouting, and astonishingly, he understood them perfectly.
hunks.sol: The black knight heard the humans’ shouts and, astonishingly, understood them perfectly.

hunks.baseline: He even understood the command that would come next.
hunks.sol: He even knew what command would come next.

hunks.baseline: —Begin concentrated fire!
hunks.sol: “Begin concentrated fire!”

hunks.baseline: It was dazzling. Flames, ice, and flashes of light erupted throughout the city.
hunks.sol: It was dazzling. Flames, ice, and flashes of light erupted from all across the city.

hunks.baseline: Some attacks came crashing down in graceful arcs. Others followed trajectories close to straight lines as they targeted the black knight and the undead knights behind him.
hunks.sol: Some attacks came crashing down in graceful arcs. Others flew in nearly straight lines, aimed at the black knight and the undead knights following behind him.

hunks.baseline: Even in a world dyed gray, the light those attacks emitted was enchanting and familiar. The black knight felt an inexplicable upheaval in his chest as he reached out a hand.
hunks.sol: Even in a world dyed gray, the light they gave off was enchanting and familiar. The black knight felt an inexplicable stirring within him and reached out.

hunks.baseline: Before the fired shells, magic, and arrows could even reach him, the pitch-black blade slashed through the air in every direction.
hunks.sol: Before the shells, magic, and arrows could reach him, the pitch-black blade carved through the air in every direction.

hunks.baseline: A magical wind stormed through the battlefield. Space split apart. The magic containing dazzling mana went out like candle flames, and the arrows shattered into pieces.
hunks.sol: A gale of magical power swept across the battlefield. Space split apart. Spells blazing with brilliant mana went out like candle flames, and arrows shattered to pieces.

hunks.baseline: Everyone in the city watched clearly as the light was devoured by darkness.
hunks.sol: Everyone in the city watched as light was devoured by darkness.

hunks.baseline: A single thought passed through Choi Minwoo’s and Shao Shen’s minds.
hunks.sol: The same thought flashed through Choi Minwoo’s and Shao Shen’s minds.

hunks.baseline: An insight approaching certainty.
hunks.sol: A realization bordering on certainty.

hunks.baseline: Then, in the next moment, a pitch-black flash leaped across space and struck the Hunters.
hunks.sol: Then, in the next instant, a pitch-black flash leaped across space and descended upon the Hunters.

hunks.baseline: A thunderous roar rang out, as if the sky itself had been split apart.
hunks.sol: A thunderous roar rang out as though the sky itself had split apart.

hunks.baseline: Dozens of tower shields shattered, and sprays of blood burst into the air. The black knight, who had cut down three A-rank Hunters and twenty B-rank Hunters with a single sword stroke, stared at the frozen humans through red glowing eyes.
hunks.sol: Dozens of tower shields shattered, and sprays of blood burst into the air. Having cut down three A-rank Hunters and twenty B-rank Hunters with a single sword stroke, the black knight stared at the frozen humans through glowing red eyes.

hunks.baseline: Beneath his deeply lowered helmet, the cold voice of the dead drifted out.
hunks.sol: From beneath his low-drawn helmet came the chilling voice of the dead.

hunks.baseline: They were the words of the Demon Realm—the final words heard by those who had died here the previous day.
hunks.sol: The Demon Realm words had been the last thing heard by those who died here the previous day.

hunks.baseline: And…
hunks.sol: And now…

hunks.baseline: They were also the order the black knight gave to the legion following behind him.
hunks.sol: They were the black knight’s command to the legion behind him.

hunks.baseline: Two Death Knights appeared to the black knight’s left and right. Then one hundred Dullahans charged in behind them, becoming sharp awls that pierced the human wall.
hunks.sol: Two Death Knights appeared to his left and right. A hundred Dullahans charged in behind them, becoming a sharp awl that pierced the human wall.

hunks.baseline: Kra-d-d-d-d-d!
hunks.sol: Krrrunch!

hunks.baseline: Emergency reports poured in from every front. Wei Fenghu shouted, demanding to know what had happened, but the answer he received was that communications with every front had been completely severed.
hunks.sol: Emergency reports had come in from every front. Wei Fenghu roared, demanding to know what had happened, but the only answer he received was that communications with every front had been completely severed.

hunks.baseline: —Completely severed? Even if communications were unstable, weren’t we still connected since last night?
hunks.sol: “Completely severed? They may have been unstable, but haven’t we still been able to connect since last night?”

hunks.baseline: The communications officer answered while sweating coldly.
hunks.sol: The communications officer answered, drenched in cold sweat.

hunks.baseline: —W-we don’t know why, but the communications interference has grown even stronger. The emergency report that just arrived was confirmed to be from approximately thirty minutes ago.
hunks.sol: “W-we don’t know why, but the interference has grown even stronger. The emergency report that just arrived appears to have been sent approximately thirty minutes ago.”

hunks.baseline: If that was true, it meant the attacks had begun while the meeting was in progress.
hunks.sol: If that was true, the attacks had begun while the meeting was in progress.

hunks.baseline: And since the report had only barely arrived after struggling through the communications interference, it might not have been thirty minutes. It could have been an hour.
hunks.sol: And since the report had barely made it through the interference, it might not have been thirty minutes ago. It could have been an hour.

hunks.baseline: Magic Johnson muttered with his face gone rigid.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson’s face went rigid.

hunks.baseline: —That can’t be. It wasn’t that bad before I left…
hunks.sol: “That can’t be. It wasn’t nearly this bad before I left…”

hunks.baseline: Suddenly, the words Magic Johnson had spoken before leaving the city flashed through my mind.
hunks.sol: The words he had spoken before leaving the city suddenly flashed through my mind.

hunks.baseline: *“Arch Lich. Its power is gradually weakening. In particular, a considerable portion of the interference disappeared after last night.”*
hunks.sol: *“The Arch Lich’s power is gradually weakening. A considerable portion of the interference has disappeared since last night in particular.”*

hunks.baseline: The Arch Lich’s power affecting the surrounding area hadn’t weakened. It had merely made it look that way.
hunks.sol: The Arch Lich’s power over the surrounding area hadn’t weakened. It had merely made it look that way.

hunks.baseline: Little by little, without giving anything away. Then, by withdrawing the legion, it had made it seem as if the range of its influence had shrunk dramatically—so that we could let our guard down even a little more.
hunks.sol: Little by little, without giving anything away. Then it withdrew its legions, making it seem as though the range of its power had shrunk dramatically—all so we would let our guard down, even if only a little.

hunks.baseline: A thoroughly prepared trap.
hunks.sol: A meticulously laid trap.

hunks.baseline: I didn’t know how the Arch Lich had realized that the S-rank Hunters were absent. What mattered was that it had seized that brief opening and sent the monster legions forward.
hunks.sol: I didn’t know how the Arch Lich had realized the S-rank Hunters were gone. What mattered was that it had seized that brief opening and sent the monster legions forward.

hunks.baseline: The thought of the horrific slaughter we had witnessed the day before happening across every front made my stomach churn even more violently than it had during my first teleportation.
hunks.sol: The thought of the horrific slaughter we had witnessed the day before now unfolding across every front made my stomach churn even worse than it had during my first teleportation.

hunks.baseline: But this time, instead of throwing up, I grabbed Magic Johnson and said,
hunks.sol: But this time, instead of throwing up, I grabbed Magic Johnson.

hunks.baseline: —What?
hunks.sol: “What?”

hunks.baseline: I expected Magic Johnson to use magic immediately. But the answer I heard next was not what I had expected.
hunks.sol: I expected Magic Johnson to use magic immediately. But his answer was nothing like what I had expected.

hunks.baseline: —Jin. Take a jet.
hunks.sol: “Jin. Take a jet.”

hunks.baseline: “What? A jet? Why are you suddenly talking about that…? We’ll be too late.”
hunks.sol: “What? A jet? Why are you suddenly…? We’ll be too late.”

hunks.baseline: —It’d be too risky right now.
hunks.sol: “It’s too risky right now.”

hunks.baseline: “Why not? You know the coordinates of the hospital rooftop where we were earlier.”
hunks.sol: “Why? You know the coordinates of the hospital rooftop where we were earlier.”

hunks.baseline: —The coordinates aren’t the problem. If we try to teleport like this…we could both die.
hunks.sol: “The coordinates aren’t the problem. If we attempt to teleport like this…we could both die.”

hunks.baseline: I had momentarily forgotten about the Arch Lich’s magical interference in my desperation. There was no way the one who had laid such a trap would kindly allow us to attempt teleportation.
hunks.sol: In my desperation, I had momentarily forgotten about the Arch Lich’s magical interference. There was no way the bastard who had laid such a trap would kindly allow us to teleport.

hunks.baseline: —Ten minutes. Twenty at most. Take the jet, Jin.
hunks.sol: “Ten minutes. Twenty at most. Take the jet, Jin.”

hunks.baseline: —Yes. But if you get yourself killed for nothing during the teleportation, there’ll be even more casualties.
hunks.sol: “Yes. But if you get yourself killed for nothing during the teleportation, there’ll be even more casualties.”

hunks.baseline: Even if I arrived late, I might still be able to save some people. But if an accident occurred during teleportation, the countless people who lost me and the reinforcements would cross a river from which there was no return.
hunks.sol: Even if I arrived late, I might still be able to save some people. But if something went wrong during the teleportation, there would be no saving me or the countless people left without reinforcements.

hunks.baseline: —It’s brave, but it’s foolish.
hunks.sol: “It’s brave, but foolish.”

hunks.baseline: —The jet will finish preparing for takeoff soon. We don’t have time for this.
hunks.sol: “The jet will be ready for takeoff soon. We don’t have time for this.”

hunks.baseline: Through the bulletproof glass occupying one side of the conference room, I could see the pilots crossing the runway and boarding the aircraft.
hunks.sol: Through the bulletproof glass covering one wall of the conference room, I could see pilots crossing the runway and boarding their aircraft.

hunks.baseline: I watched the scene in silence, then suddenly spoke.
hunks.sol: I watched in silence, then suddenly spoke.

hunks.baseline: —What?
hunks.sol: “What?”

hunks.baseline: —Jin, don’t tell me…
hunks.sol: “Jin, don’t tell me…”

hunks.baseline: “There’s no need for you to risk yourself too, Johnson. I’m enough on my own.”
hunks.sol: “There’s no need for you to risk yourself too, Johnson. Sending me alone will be enough.”

hunks.baseline: —Good God. Are you crazy? I explained it to you, and you still don’t understand!
hunks.sol: “Good God. Are you crazy? I explained it to you, and you still don’t understand!”

hunks.baseline: “I understand perfectly. And I’m prepared to go that far.”
hunks.sol: “I understand perfectly. I’m prepared to take that risk.”

hunks.baseline: —You…
hunks.sol: “You…”

hunks.baseline: His lips moved as if he were about to say something, but then he suddenly slammed his fist down on the table.
hunks.sol: His lips moved as though he were about to say something, but then he suddenly slammed his fist down on the table.

hunks.baseline: —Damn it! What the fuck is this!
hunks.sol: “Damn it! Fuck this whole goddamn mess!”

hunks.baseline: I let out a quiet laugh as I watched Magic Johnson mutter one curse after another.
hunks.sol: I let out a quiet laugh as I watched Magic Johnson mutter curse after curse.

hunks.baseline: “I can take that as your permission, right?”
hunks.sol: “I can take that as permission, right?”

hunks.baseline: —Yes, you insolent little brat.
hunks.sol: “Yes, you insolent little brat.”

hunks.baseline: He looked as if he might start hurling abuse at me.
hunks.sol: He looked ready to unleash another torrent of abuse.

hunks.baseline: Magic Johnson was genuinely furious—and at the same time, he was grieving.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson was genuinely furious—and at the same time, deeply saddened.

hunks.baseline: —Listen, Jin. I…
hunks.sol: “Listen, Jin. I…”

hunks.baseline: “I know. You have people you need to protect, too. I’m sorry to ask you this.”
hunks.sol: “I know. You have people you need to protect too. I’m sorry to ask this of you.”

hunks.baseline: —……Damn it. Is sending you to the hospital rooftop enough?
hunks.sol: “……Damn it. The hospital rooftop, right?”

hunks.baseline: Magic Johnson clenched his teeth and placed his thick palm against my chest.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson clenched his teeth and pressed his thick palm against my chest.

hunks.baseline: As though taking every possible precaution, his mana began to slowly wrap around my body, unlike the first time he had teleported me.
hunks.sol: As though taking every possible precaution, his mana slowly began to envelop my body, unlike the first time he had teleported me.

hunks.baseline: —Ten percent. That’s your chance of survival. There’s a ninety percent chance you could die.
hunks.sol: “Ten percent. Those are your odds of survival. There’s a ninety percent chance you’ll die.”

hunks.baseline: I raised my head and looked up at the sky beyond the window.
hunks.sol: I raised my head and looked at the sky beyond the window.

hunks.baseline: A clear blue expanse without a single cloud. Was Murim somewhere in the distant universe above that sky? Were they waiting for me?
hunks.sol: A clear blue expanse without a single cloud. Was Murim somewhere in the distant universe beyond that sky? Were they waiting for me?

hunks.baseline: —What?
hunks.sol: “What?”

hunks.baseline: A dazzling mass of light burst forth. Feeling warmth envelop my entire body, I continued,
hunks.sol: A dazzling mass of light burst forth. Feeling warmth envelop my entire body, I continued.

hunks.baseline: I wanted to know, but unfortunately, I could no longer see his face. Along with the blinding flash blocking my vision came a rough, powerful force that sucked me beyond the distorting space.
hunks.sol: I wanted to know, but unfortunately, I could no longer see his face. A blinding flash filled my vision, and a rough, powerful force sucked me through the warping space.
